description: Agent Datasets: submit a dataset’s privacy claims with its contents and handling records: the claim with whether the dataset is said to be anonymized and whether it holds personal data, and its wording, read for anonymized, de-identified, no personal data or non-identifiable; each field with its name, kind (a direct identifier, a quasi-identifier, sensitive or other) and treatment (removed, hashed, tokenized, encrypted, masked, generalized or none); a sample of records, each with its id and its values as written; the handling record with the legal basis (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, legitimate interests or none stated), whether consent is recorded, the days data is kept, the deletion process and who can reach the data (public, restricted or internal); and optionally the smallest group a quasi-identifier combination may form (5 when left out). The signed report gives every field with its kind, treatment, the identifier kinds found in its values and its status as exposed, pseudonymized, sensitive_open or treated, the identifiers found by kind, field and record with the values never repeated, the re-identification reading with the groups the quasi-identifiers form in the sample, the smallest group and the groups below the threshold, the handling with the basis, consent, retention, deletion and access, and counts them, and names exposed data: an untreated direct identifier, an identifier-shaped value where none should remain, quasi-identifier groups below the threshold under an anonymity claim, personal data the claim denies, no legal basis, unrecorded consent and untreated sensitive fields in public data; then direct identifiers only hashed, tokenized or encrypted under an anonymity claim, no deletion process and small groups with no anonymity claim, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No fields or sample, an unstated kind or treatment, legal basis, retention or access, and declared quasi-identifiers with no sample leave privacy unverified. This reads one dataset’s contents: privacy claims against a policy document are wever_privacy-evidence-check, a retention and deletion policy is wever_data-retention-check and the purposes a consent grant covers are wever_consent-purpose-check. Verdict dataset_privacy_exposed, dataset_privacy_partial, dataset_privacy_unverified or dataset_privacy_protected. POST /api/dataset-privacy-check. Reads the dataset records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Datasets reads a dataset’s own records and checks what is claimed about it: its quality claims against its own sample and profile, its current schema against the documented or prior one, its license against the intended use, its synthetic-data disclosure against its provenance, its freshness against its update log, its lineage against its source records, its privacy claims against its contents and handling, and its coverage against the population it is said to represent. Beside it, wever_data-evidence-check inspects one JSON sample field by field and wever_evaluation-dataset-check reads an evaluation set against what an agent must handle, while a dataset check reads a claim made about a dataset against the dataset’s own records; wever_license-evidence-check names the license family a text matches, while the license check reads the terms against one intended use; and wever_privacy-evidence-check reads privacy claims against a policy document, while the privacy check reads the dataset’s contents and handling records. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-datasets-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-datasets/.

anonymized.description: Whether the dataset is said to be anonymized.

text.description: Read for wording such as anonymized, no personal data or de-identified.

k_threshold.description: The smallest group a quasi-identifier combination may form; 5 when left out.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

value.description: As written; leave it out for an empty cell.
